rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Bans selling, licensing or providing an algorithmic device (software using nonpublic competitor data to recommend rents or occupancy) to a landlord, and bans landlords from using one to set rental rates or occupancy levels. Excludes aggregated reports from public or 90+ day-old data and affordable housing program tools. Tenants may sue for remedies.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus costs and reasonable attorney's fees
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11, §§98.1101-98.1104 (O-2025-107)
rules.status_basis: Proposed ordinance: number and date of final passage blank, staff report proposing adoption. Takes effect on the thirtieth day after final passage.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property in the City of San Diego regardless of building age or size.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Excludes software that publishes aggregated reports from public or historical data and software used to set rents under affordable housing program guidelines.

rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
